pages.text: $(bold)The Moon: Entry Point to Space$()$(br)Mobs: $(bold){{dim ad_astra:moon difficulty}}$() the vanilla strength, like every Tier 4 world$(br)Death penalty: $(bold){{dim ad_astra:moon death}}$()$(br2)Your first extraterrestrial destination: no oxygen, low gravity and a stark landscape of Moon Stone and Moon Sand. Hostile mobs with Jump Boost II patrol the surface.

$(bold)Low Gravity Combat$()$(br)The Moon's low gravity changes how fights go:$(br)• $(bold)Knockback is doubled$(): hits send you and mobs flying$(br)• $(bold)Slow Falling$() the whole time: you float down and take no fall damage$(br)• Projectiles travel further$(br2)Melee builds have to keep closing the distance. Ranged builds do well here.

$(bold)What to Bring$()$(br)• Space suit with oxygen$(br)• Building materials for a temporary base$(br)• Oxygen Loader and an RF power source$(br)• Mining tools for Moon Stone$(br2)$(bold)What to Mine$()$(br)The $(bold)Tier 2 Rocket$() that takes you to Mars needs ores and materials only the Moon has. The structures on the lunar surface hold more loot.

$(bold)Planetary Rock Extraction$()$(br)Crush $(bold)Moon Stone$() in Create Crushing Wheels or a Thermal Pulverizer to extract:$(br)• $(bold)Helium-3 Isotope$() (25%): rare fusion fuel$(br)• $(bold)Titanium Dust$() (15%): lightweight alloy material$(br)• Iron Nuggets (50%)$(br2)The Thermal Pulverizer gives slightly better odds than crushing wheels.

$(bold)Lunar Stride Enchantment$()$(br)Chests on the Moon hold books of $(bold)Lunar Stride$(): level I in 30% of them, level II in 10% (max level 3). On armor, on any planet, it:$(br)• Reduces fall damage by 33% a level$(br)• Grants Jump Boost$(br)• Stops fall damage at 4 levels across your armor$(br2)Melee builds in low gravity need it.
